answers.reason: The full professor is a member of the university and takes part where their matters are decided, but the senate is for university-wide statutes and strategy.
The budget planning round is managed by leadership and central administration, not the full professor.
The appointment committee selects candidates for vacant professorships, which directly concerns a full professor.
The faculty council decides faculty affairs, and the full professor holds a chair in the faculty.
The study commission deals with degree programmes and teaching, which falls under faculty academic matters.
Examination boards decide on individual student examination matters.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects, fitting a research-active full professor.
Module revisions concern specific degree programme modules handled by a dedicated working group.
Laboratory equipment procurement chooses equipment for teaching laboratories within the faculty.
Orientation week planning is for the first week of new students.
